fusions.name: Longstaff Drill
fusions.desc: Thrusts a long branch that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Grain-True Form
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 28 damage and always lands as a critical hit. It leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Rooted Stance
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rings of Practice
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 10. When you reach 10, they all spend at once: you gain a shield of bark that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
